identity: We know little about them, but we noticed they lack super-speed and hypnotic eyes.  If they had, I wouldn't send you on your own against them.  Approach during the day, so combat will result in them slowly burning under the sun or attacking you with an umbrella.  Unlike the previous missions, this one can be completed by luring the undead hordes at the target so they kill each other.  However, try to speak with them first to see if they want to be cured.

identity: Announcement of rare elements discovery near the Canadian border.  The US government has discovered what they are calling an unexpected windfall of rare elements on the border with Canada.  At these sites large domes with irising roofs have been erected before anti-satellite measures were enacted.  The government claims that these domes were built  "In order to protect the natural environment surrounding these mineral deposits"  Some people living nearby the domes have claimed increased UFO activity after the domes began, but satellite images no longer seem able to view these regions and drones attempting to enter the restricted areas cease to work.
